As a Welding Coordinator in Alkmaar, you work 40 hours a week. You are responsible for the highest welding quality in the production of stainless steel hoses, flow systems, and skids. You ensure everything meets ISO 3834-2. This makes the job challenging and varied. You work with different teams and are the point of contact for welding technical questions.
Your day starts with a team meeting. After that, you check ongoing welding projects. You set up procedures, perform quality controls, and give advice to colleagues. You train employees and work together with suppliers and external inspectors. No day is the same!
Are you precise and do you enjoy working with technology? Do you want a key role in an innovative company? Apply quickly and make the difference as a Welding Coordinator! 🚀

- MBO diploma in a technical direction (for example Mechanical Engineering or Welding Technology)

- At least 2 years of experience as a welding coordinator or similar

- Knowledge of welding processes and quality standards (ISO 3834-2, ISO 5817)

- Certificate IWS, IWT, or IWE is a plus

- You speak and write English well

- You work precisely and are communicative

- You live a maximum of 30 km from Alkmaar
